title: Torsion-Induced Modification to Friedmann Equations in $AdSL_{4}$ Gauged Gravity
summary: We study the solution of the gravitational field equations in $AdSL_{4}$-gauged gravity, a gauge-theoretic extension of general relativity based on the $AdSL_{4}$ algebra. In this formulation, the antisymmetric gauge field $B^{ab}$, associated with additional $AdSL_{4}$ tensorial generators, induces space-time torsion via the relation $K^{ab}=μB^{ab}$, where $K^{ab}$ denotes the contorsion 1-form.
